summary: The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund (“ETF”) that invests in a concentrated portfolio of equity and equity-related securities of large and mid-capitalization companies with market capitalization over USD 5 Billion at time of purchase and issued by emerging market companies. The fund is non-diversified.
